SEARCH
Package com.smu.mtc.mtcbean

Interface MTC_Data_Dao<N,I>

Type Parameters:
N - node record type used by the selected tree design.
I - node index type used by the selected tree design.
All Known Subinterfaces:
MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao, MTC_Baseline_Data_Dao
All Known Implementing Classes:
MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL, MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite, MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite, MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite_Common
public interface MTC_Data_Dao<N,I>
Database-neutral persistence contract shared by both MTC tree designs.

Applications normally implement one of the specialized interfaces rather than this interface directly:

  • MTC_Baseline_Data_Dao for the baseline design;
  • MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao for the append-only design.

An adapter may use SQL, a document database, or a remote storage service. It must preserve record values exactly, use millisecond timestamps, return empty collections instead of null, and return getNodesByIndices(ArrayList) results in the same order as the requested indices. Single-record lookups return null when no matching record exists, and getLatestTimestamp() returns 0 for an empty state store.

For atomic build rounds, transactional adapters should additionally implement DaoSupport. See the Javadoc overview's Integrating a Different Database section for an integration checklist and reference implementations.
